Short title and commencement

ACT XXXIII OF 1994
SINDH COAL AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXXIII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-28/94, dated
22-2-1995.--The Coal Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been passed by
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th December, 1994 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 1995 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Act, 1994.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 7 of Sindh Act No.VI of 1994

ACT XXXIII OF 1994
SINDH COAL AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXXIII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-28/94, dated
22-2-1995.--The Coal Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been passed by
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th December, 1994 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 1995 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
2. Amendment of section 7 of Sindh Act No.VI of 1994.--In the Sindh
Coal Authority Act, 1994, in section 7, in subsection (1), for clause (vi), the
following shall be substituted:--
"(vi) Two Members of the
National Assembly from Sindh to be nominated by
the Assembly.
Official Members
(vii) Four Members of the Provincial Assembly to be nominated by
the
Assembly;
Official Members
(viii) Two Non-Official Members
to be nominated by Government.
Non-Official Members."

Repeal

ACT XXXIII OF 1994
SINDH COAL AUTHORITY (AMENDMENT) ACT, 1994
ACT XXXIII OF 1994
An Act to amend the Sindh Coal Authority Act, 1994
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part IV, 22nd February, 1994]
No. PAS/Legis-B-28/94, dated
22-2-1995.--The Coal Authority (Amendment) Bill, 1994 having been passed by
Provincial Assembly of Sindh on 28th December, 1994 and assented to by the
Governor of Sindh on 12th February, 1995 is hereby published as an
Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
3. Repeal.--The Sindh Coal Authority (Amendment) Ordinance, 1994,
is hereby repealed.
